DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot log in using a registered email
    address and an incorrect password, and that an appropriate error
    message is displayed.
NAME: T03: Login with incorrect password.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can subscribe to the newsletter
    from the home page by entering a valid email address and that
    the subscription success message is displayed.
NAME: T30: Verify subscription on the home page.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot proceed with registration
    when entering an email address with an invalid format and that
    the appropriate email validation message is displayed.
NAME: T09: Signup with invalid email format.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can filter products by a selected brand,
    that the corresponding brand products page is displayed, and that
    all displayed products belong to the selected brand.
NAME: T24: Filter products by brand.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can submit the contact us form
    by providing their name, email, subject, and message, uploading
    a file, and confirming the submission alert.
    The success confirmation message should be displayed afterward.
NAME: T29: Submit the contact us form.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can remove a product from the cart
    and that the cart is empty after the product is deleted.
NAME: T19: Delete product from cart.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can select a product category
    and subcategory and that all displayed products belong to
    the selected category and subcategory.
NAME: T25: Filter products by category and subcategory.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a new user can successfully create an account
    by providing valid registration details and that the account
    creation confirmation message is displayed.
NAME: T07: Successful signup with valid data.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that searching for a product that does not exist
    in the catalog returns no matching products and displays the
    appropriate no-results state.
NAME: T23: Search for a non-existent product.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can add a recommended product
    to the cart from the home page and that the product name and price
    are displayed correctly in the cart.
NAME: T20: Add recommended product to cart.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that after adding a selected product to the cart,
    the product name and price are displayed correctly in the cart.
NAME: T17: Verify product information in cart.
T14: Verify product details.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a logged-in user can complete the purchase
    flow by adding a product to the cart, proceeding to checkout,
    providing payment details, and confirming the order successfully.
NAME: T26: Complete purchase flow.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot log in when the password field
    is left empty and that the appropriate validation message is displayed.
NAME: T05: Login with empty password field.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a new user cannot create an account
    using an email address that is already registered and that
    an appropriate error message is displayed.
NAME: T08: Signup with an existing email.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can search for a product by name
    and that the expected product is displayed in the search results.
NAME: T22: Search product by name.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot proceed with registration
    when the email field is left empty and that the appropriate
    email validation message is displayed.
NAME: T11: Signup with empty email field.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a logged-in user can successfully log out
    and is redirected to the login page.
NAME: T06: Successful logout.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a product added to the cart before login
    remains in the cart after the user logs in, and that the product
    name and price are displayed correctly.
NAME: T21: Verify cart contents after login.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a registered user can successfully delete
    their account and that the account deletion confirmation message
    is displayed.
NAME: T12: Successful account deletion.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot log in using a validly formatted
    email address that is not registered on the website and that an
    appropriate error message is displayed.
NAME: T02: Login with unregistered email.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can submit a review for a selected
    product by providing their name, email, and review text, and that
    the review submission confirmation message is displayed.
NAME: T15: Submit a review for a product.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot proceed with registration
    when the name field is left empty and that the appropriate
    name validation message is displayed.
NAME: T10: Signup with empty name field.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can set the desired product quantity
    before adding the product to the cart and that the selected quantity
    and total price are displayed correctly in the cart.
NAME: T18: Verify product quantity and total price in cart.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that the delivery address displayed during checkout
    matches the address details provided when the user account was created.
NAME: T27: Verify delivery address details in checkout.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can add a selected product to the cart
    and that the confirmation modal is displayed after the product
    is added successfully.
NAME: T16: Add product to cart and verify confirmation.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can subscribe to the newsletter
    from the cart page by entering a valid email address and that
    the subscription success message is displayed.
NAME: T31: Verify subscription on the cart page.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a registered user can successfully log in
    using valid email and password credentials.
NAME: T01: Successful login with valid credentials.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a logged-in user can complete a purchase,
    download the invoice, and verify that the downloaded file contains
    the expected product price.
NAME: T28: Download and verify invoice after purchase.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user can navigate to the products page
    and that the products are displayed correctly.
NAME: T13: Verify products page is displayed.

DESCRIPTION:
This test verifies that a user cannot log in when the email field
    is left empty and that the appropriate validation message is displayed.
NAME: T04: Login with empty email field.
